title: Successful user registration with valid data
description: Verify that a new user can register with valid credentials and required information, and that the user is directed to the next necessary step.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page
Enter a valid email, strong password, and other required registration details
Submit the registration form
Confirm registration is successful and user is prompted for optional MFA setup or welcome page

title: Registration fails with invalid email format
description: Check that the registration form validates and rejects emails that are not correctly formatted.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page
Input an invalid email format, valid password and other required fields
Submit the registration form
Verify error message indicating invalid email format is displayed and submission is blocked

title: Login success with correct credentials
description: Ensure that a user can successfully login with valid credentials and is redirected appropriately.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input valid username/email and password
Click the login button
Confirm successful login and landing on the main authenticated user dashboard

title: Login blocked with incorrect credentials
description: Verify that login with incorrect username or password is rejected with appropriate feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter invalid username/email and/or password
Click the login button
Verify error message is shown indicating invalid credentials

title: Optional Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) setup and verification
description: Test that users can opt-in to MFA, complete setup and successfully login with MFA challenge.

steps.description: Login with valid credentials
Navigate to MFA setup and enable MFA
Complete MFA setup following instructions (e.g., scanning QR code, entering code)
Logout and attempt login again with correct credentials
Enter MFA token when prompted
Confirm successful login with MFA enabled

title: Demo mode access and product tour
description: Validate that users can enter demo mode quickly without providing real credentials and explore the main product features.

steps.description: Navigate to the landing page
Select demo mode option
Verify access to demo mode user interface without requiring login
Navigate through demo screens including AppFactory and key features
Confirm content loads properly and demo mode navigation functions smoothly

title: Discover profiles and like flow
description: Ensure that users can browse profiles in Discover, like them and that likes are registered accurately.

steps.description: Login and navigate to /discover
Verify multiple profiles display with correct information and UI elements
Like a profile
Confirm like is registered and UI updates accordingly
Like multiple profiles and verify no UI crashes

title: Match generation and access
description: Validate that when two users like each other, a match is generated and accessible in the Matches UI.

steps.description: Two users like each other's profiles
Login as one user and navigate to /matches
Verify the matched profiles appear in the Matches list
Attempt to access chat with the matched profile
Confirm chat access is granted for matched users

title: Chat access restriction without match
description: Confirm users cannot access the chat screen or send messages to a profile without a mutual match.

steps.description: Login and attempt to access chat with a profile that is not matched
Confirm access is denied or user is redirected appropriately
Try to send chat messages to unmatched profile
Verify messages cannot be sent or saved

title: Real-time chat message send and receive
description: Test that chat messages between matched users appear in real-time without page refresh.

steps.description: User A sends a message in chat with User B
User B receives the message instantly in chat UI
User B replies to User A
User A receives reply instantly

title: Private gallery locking and unlocking with CMPX tokens
description: Verify that private gallery contents are blurred/locked by default and can be unlocked only after token payment.

steps.description: Access a matched user's private gallery
Confirm gallery images are blurred or locked initially
Attempt to unlock gallery by initiating CMPX token payment
Verify tokens are deducted correctly and gallery images become clear
Attempt unlocking with insufficient tokens balance
Confirm unlock is denied and error message about insufficient tokens displays

title: Tokens and wallet dashboard rendering and navigation
description: Ensure token balances (CMPX/GTK) and transaction dashboards display accurately and token navigation links work.

steps.description: Login and navigate to /tokens
Confirm CMPX and GTK token balances display correctly
Navigate through token dashboard tabs and sub-navigation items
Verify token transaction history loads and navigation is smooth without errors

title: Responsive navigation works on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices
description: Validate top and bottom navigation elements adapt appropriately across different viewport sizes and remain fully operational.

steps.description: Open the application on a mobile viewport
Check navigation elements render correctly without overlap or cutoff
Repeat navigation check on tablet viewport
Verify layout and navigation usability
Repeat navigation check on desktop viewport
Confirm navigation is fully functional and correct

title: Profile single and couple views render and edit
description: Verify that single and couple profile views load with the correct details and editing profiles updates information correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to a single profile view
Confirm profile details render correctly
Edit fields and save changes in single profile editor
Verify updates are saved and reflected on profile
Repeat steps for a couple profile view and editor

title: Events and clubs display verified listings and upcoming events
description: Check the /events and /clubs pages show verified listings correctly and upcoming clubs/events are highlighted.

steps.description: Login and navigate to /events
Verify events are listed with required details including verification status
Navigate to /clubs
Confirm clubs listing displays with upcoming clubs shown prominently

title: Admin panel access control by user role
description: Ensure that only users with admin or moderator roles can access respective administrative and moderation pages.

steps.description: Login as a regular user and attempt to navigate to /admin and /moderators pages
Verify access is denied or redirected appropriately
Login as an admin user and navigate to /admin pages
Confirm admin pages load correctly without errors
Login as a moderator and access moderation pages
Verify moderator pages load and restricted functions are accessible

title: AI Help and AI Control Center accessibility and functionality
description: Verify AI help features load and provide relevant assistance, and controls in AI Center can be accessed and used.

steps.description: Login and navigate to AI Control Center
Confirm AI help UI loads without errors
Invoke AI assistance features and verify relevant responses are displayed
Check AI control toggles or commands execute as expected

title: Marketplace, Shop, and NFTs screens render correctly
description: Ensure the marketplace, shop, and NFTs pages display content properly and do not crash even when features are incomplete.

steps.description: Navigate to /marketplace
Verify marketplace items load and UI is stable
Navigate to /shop and /nfts
Confirm shop and NFTs pages render without UI crashes or errors

title: Legal and Info pages content and navigation
description: Validate all legal and information pages like terms of service, privacy policy, support, and compliance load correctly and navigation between them works.

steps.description: Navigate to /legal, /privacy, /terms, /support, /ley-olimpia pages
Verify page content is displayed correctly and is readable
Click internal links between info pages
Confirm navigation completes without errors and pages update properly
